about.title: Designer. Writer. Developer.
about.quote:
I build what I used to have to explain.
From idea to design to working code.
about.bio1: I love it when something just works. When an idea, a design and the execution fit together seamlessly.
about.bio2: My path was anything but straight. From the Gerrit Rietveld Academie to SAE Institute and the Schrijversacademie, always searching for how to make something not just beautiful, but also understandable.
about.bio3: After years working in the automotive industry (Renault, Pieter Smit) and for clients like the Municipality of Amsterdam and KLM, I noticed something frustrating: I could see exactly what could be better… but I couldn't always build it myself.
about.bio4: So I decided to change that. I retrained as a Full Stack Developer at NOVI College. Because I no longer wanted a gap between idea and execution.
about.bio5: In plain terms: I solve technical problems and build the website that goes with the solution. No detours, no separate specialists working past each other. One person who takes it from idea to launch.
about.journalCta: Curious how I think and work? In my journal I write about code, design and my path into development.

testimonials.label: What clients say
testimonials.title: Reviews
testimonials.sub: Real experiences from people I have worked with.

saskia.quote: Professional, decisive and collaborative! A breath of fresh air. And great that she dares to think 'out of the box'. I recommend Manon 100%!

marie.quote: During my recovery (I headbutted a mountain in the Alps and rattled my brain), I told ManonIT that I wanted to give my creative stories and ideas a place on my own website. She took care of everything from there. She asked about my wishes regarding style, setup and background, and built it faster than I could type. Now that my website is live, all I can say is: Manon, thank you for listening, for building, for rebuilding after good consultation, and of course for the aftercare with an extensive manual! I dreamed it up, ManonIT built it.

villa.quote: I thought we just needed a few pages. Manon kept asking questions until she could tell the story of Villa Vredestein better than I could at the bar. The result: a site with no frills, exactly like us, yet surprising enough to keep visitors reading longer than planned. Then she went and built a rental dashboard for our student rooms too, complete with payments, contracts and a cleaning schedule, and suddenly I had no spreadsheet left to curse at.

terms: No lease: after 24 months your website is yours. If you then want to keep hosting and changes, the subscription continues and you can cancel monthly.

items.q: Why is this more expensive than a cheap subscription or Wix?
items.a: With cheap subscriptions you get a standard site that stays with the provider. With me you get a design that fits your brand, with copy and build from the same person, and after 24 months the website is yours.
24 months. After that the subscription can be cancelled monthly and your website is yours.

items.q: I'd rather not have a subscription.
items.a: Then look at the project prices: a website for a fixed amount, with no term. They are below under rates.
Yes. You then pay off the remaining build part, about €20 to 30 per remaining month. After 24 months that is no longer needed.
Yes, with a fixed price in advance. You can also move up to a bigger plan.

items.q: Is the domain in my name?
items.a: Yes. Your domain is always in your name.

items.q: What if you get ill or stop?
items.a: Your domain is in your name, backups are made daily and every site comes with a handover document. You can take everything with you.
I write it for you, based on our conversation. If you already have text, I'll work it in. That way your site sounds like you, without you facing a blank page.
I make small changes for you, within your monthly changes. If you want to manage text, photos and blog yourself, a website with CMS from the project prices fits better.
